name: Inspira UI
summary: Open-source collection of 150+ animated Vue and Nuxt components, built on shadcn-vue and motion-v.
description: Component library for Vue and Nuxt with 150+ animated components across backgrounds, cards, interactions, text effects and visualizations, including HTML-in-canvas and WebGL scenes. Each component page shows live previews, props, API notes and copy-ready source; built on shadcn-vue, motion-v and Tailwind CSS, MIT licensed.
